title: RentGuard Reinstatement Terms — Quick Reference
content:
**RentGuard Renters Policy — reinstatement after a nonpayment cancellation.** Three tier figures govern reinstatement: the reinstatement window in calendar days after the cancellation date, the tier's reinstatement fee, and the number of reinstatements allowed in a rolling 12 months.

| Tier | Reinstatement window (calendar days after the cancellation date) | Tier reinstatement fee (USD) | Reinstatements allowed per rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 15 | 15.00 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 15 | 15.00 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 30 | 15.00 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 30 | 10.00 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 30 | 0.00 | 2 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 45 | 0.00 | 2 |

**Reading the table**

- The window is 15 days on HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential, 30 days on HO-4 Enhanced, HO-4 Premier and HO-4 Premier Plus, and 45 days on HO-4 Signature.
- The tier reinstatement fee is 15.00 on the three lower tiers, 10.00 on HO-4 Premier and 0.00 on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
- One reinstatement per rolling 12 months is allowed on the four lower tiers; two on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
